finding.shortLabel: Peter's King Philip's War service and 1676 death
finding.statement: Peter Gurney, John Gurney-1's youngest documented son, served as a soldier in Captain Isaac Johnson's company, surviving the Narragansett campaign's Great Swamp Fight of 19 December 1675, and was killed later in the war, in 1676.

finding.shortLabel: Bodge: Peter Gurney, Capt. Isaac Johnson's company, Dedham muster 1675

sources.locator: p. 114 (Capt. Isaac Johnson's company, Weymouth file, "Peeter Gurnay"; Dedham muster 10 Dec 1675), pp. 112-114 (company narrative and casualty list).

finding.statement: George Madison Bodge's roll of King Philip's War soldiers lists "Peeter Gurnay" under Weymouth in Captain Isaac Johnson's company, mustered at Dedham on 10 December 1675 for the Narragansett campaign, and absent from that company's list of the Great Swamp Fight's December 1675 dead and wounded.
